name: electron_ou_experimental_reference_publication
description: Three experimental material scenarios evaluated as separate source-consistent points and overlaid on the Cartesian sensitivity map.

noise_scenarios.label: Purified 12C CVD bath
noise_scenarios.material: CVD diamond, approximately 1 ppm substitutional nitrogen and 0.01% 13C

calibration.conversion_note: The Lorentzian coupling scale Delta is identified with the rms detuning width and converted from cycles/s to angular frequency.

noise_scenarios.notes: Direct bath spectral decomposition; source-native Delta and tau_c are used together.

noise_scenarios.label: Intermediate HPHT bath
noise_scenarios.source: Hayashi et al., JPSJ 89, 054708 (2020), sample No. 8
noise_scenarios.material: HPHT-grown diamond; P1 density 1.2e17 cm^-3 and NV density 1.1e17 cm^-3

calibration.conversion_note: Hayashi uses H_I=lambda f(t) sigma_z. Under H_noise=beta(t) Z/2, beta=2 lambda f; lambda is converted from MHz to angular frequency.

noise_scenarios.notes: The plotted lambda and tau_c are rounded; they must not be quoted with greater precision.

noise_scenarios.label: Engineered 12C, 2 ppm N
noise_scenarios.source: Bauch et al., Physical Review B 102, 134210 (2020)
noise_scenarios.material: Representative 99.95%+ 12C ensemble with 2 ppm substitutional nitrogen
noise_scenarios.role: engineered-material benchmark derived from measured concentration scaling

calibration.conversion_note: T2* and T2 are evaluated from the measured concentration laws at 2 ppm, then converted to one OU pair by matching the Ramsey and Hahn-echo envelopes. No echo pulse is used during gate propagation.

noise_scenarios.notes: This is a concentration-scaled material benchmark, not a separately tabulated sample row.
